label: Suez Canal Annual Revenue
change: H1 FY2025/26 (Jul–Dec 2025): $1.97B, +17.5% YoY. SCA Chairman Rabie forecasts ~$8B for FY2026/27 as Red Sea shipping recovers post-Houthi disruptions. source: Suez Canal Authority / Arab News / Egyptian Streets, February–June 2026; The National, August 25 2026
